regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: T6CL02 scans a per-day working/non-working table to count WS-WORKING-DAYS, then computes WS-DELAY-DAYS = WS-WORKING-DAYS - 7 (line 28) and multiplies by 500. The penalty accrues per working day of delay, not per calendar day as clause 19 requires.
